exposure: Gestational weight gain (GWG) classified as insufficient or excessive according to IOM guidelines
cohort: 620 pregnant women either treated with levothyroxine or attended due to hyperthyroidism during pregnancy were included.
finding: Gestational weight gain (GWG) according to IOM guidelines, both insufficient and excessive, was significantly associated with various adverse maternal and fetal pregnancy outcomes in women with thyroid disorders.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
